learnings: Tool errors (HTTP 502, timeouts) should trigger automatic retry or escalation rather than producing an inconclusive verdict that triggers expensive multi-model review
When one model fails due to infrastructure error and another succeeds with full coverage, the successful review should be weighted heavily unless there are independent reasons for suspicion
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to analysis uncertainty' and 'inconclusive due to tool failure' - the latter should not count as a disagreement signal
